responsibility: This definition file extends GCC’s generic tree-code universe with node kinds that exist only in the GNU C front end. In this module it declares the C-only C_TOKEN_VEC tree code, used to represent deferred-parsing token vectors, and thus serves as input to the tree-code generation machinery that assigns enums, names, and classifications consumed by the C parser and other front-end code that manipulates these language-specific tree nodes.
same_name_distinction: Unlike gcc/c/c-tree.h, which is the broad public header for C front-end tree flags, macros, globals, and APIs, this .def file is the generator input that lists the C-specific tree-code definitions themselves—here adding the C-only C_TOKEN_VEC node kind for the tree-code machinery.
